text:
Avery: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a 'shepherd' pattern to manage v1->v2 API migrations per-tenant. Idea is lightweight, short-lived shims that we can spin up/tear down without touching core gateway.

Sam: Curious — why per-tenant instead of gateway-wide feature flags?

Priya: Per-tenant gives finer rollout control and rollback without broad blast radius. Also lets us collect tenant-specific delta metrics. Latency hit should be small (~1ms) if we keep shim minimal.

Jorge: Main downside is lifecycle and cleanup complexity. Who owns tombstoning and eventual removal?

Avery: Ownership proposal: eng-platform owns the shepherd controller. Shim types we support: proxy-layer shim (preferred for streaming/frame compatibility), runtime-adapter (in-process), and client-compat SDKs. Default for web customers = proxy-layer.

Maya: Streaming is the hairy bit — proxy must preserve chunk framing and KV cache headers. We should standardize a header for negotiation, e.g.

```
X-Compat-Version: v1->v2
X-Shepherd-Id: cohort-2026-03
```

Sam: Header gating + allowlist works. We also need metric names to track impact: `compat.latency_ms`, `compat.error_rate`, `compat.mismatch_count`.

Priya: Ops checklist draft: TTL for shims (default 30d), migration feature toggle, canary progression 1% -> 10% -> 100%, automated rollback if error_rate > 2x baseline.

Jorge: Telemetry note: scrub PII from payloads before storing. Use hashed tenant IDs for correlation.

Avery: Action items:
- Sam: prototype proxy shim with header gating (due EOD Tue)
- Maya: add streaming chunk-framing test harness
- Priya: draft rollout playbook + concrete rollback criteria
- Jorge: implement telemetry sanitizer for compat events

deploy-bot: deploy requested: `shepherd/proxy-shim:canary` -> staging at 1718200300 :rocket:

Sam: pushed initial branch https://git.internal/r/redwood/shepherd/proxy-shim/pull/12 :eyes:

Priya: I'll book a 30m sync Thu 10:00 to review canary metrics and decide progression.

Avery: Small policy detail — shims should auto-expire and emit deprecation events at 30/15/7/0 days remaining so customers get nudges.

Maya: +1, also add `compat-testset` that runs against both v1 and v2 on every PR.

Sam: any strong objections to per-tenant shepherd model? If not I'll start the prototype today.

Priya: No objections from me. Please include a rough SLO/latency budget in the prototype notes.

Avery: Thanks — I'll capture these notes in the RFC follow-up doc and link the prototype once Sam has it.
